name: constrained_deadline
description: 3-task set with deadline < period, chosen so RM's period-order and DM's deadline-order disagree: RM priority order is B > C > A (by ascending period 150/250/300), DM priority order is A > B > C (by ascending deadline 100/140/200) -- task A has the shortest deadline but the longest period. Total utilization (budget/period) is 0.6, comfortably schedulable under either policy. Matches SCHED_TASKSET=1 in Code/schedPolicy.h and the vSchedulerPeriodicTaskCreate() calls in Code/main/main.ino.
